questions.question: She _______ (has just) finished her project by the time we arrived yesterday. The correct form is essential for expressing an action completed just before another.
If I _______ (had known) about the meeting, I would have attended instead of staying at home.
She says she _______ (doesn’t like) spicy food, but she always eats it anyway.
We _______ (should have) left earlier to avoid the traffic.
She is very _______ (talented) at painting, but she rarely gets the chance to exhibit her work.
They _______ (must have been) exhausted after working all night. Their tone suggested they were very tired.
She _______ (to go) to the store to buy some milk, but she forgot and had to ask her neighbour.
He _______ (could have) finished the report yesterday if he had started earlier. The sentence uses modal verbs for possibility.
The meeting _______ (to be) postponed because of the weather conditions. This uses the passive form with an infinitive.
They _______ (since) moving to London, they’ve been working remotely. This question focuses on the present perfect continuous tense.
